liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Box of Rain** (1 review): Reviewer finds this version sweet but somewhat weak, suggesting Phil needs a different song to sing [11]
- **Touch Of Grey** (1 review): Reviewer calls it standard, lacking the charm a smile from Jerry would bring [11]
- **Louie, Louie** (1 review): Reviewer especially liked Louie Louie opening the second set [20]
- **The Other One** (1 review): Reviewer describes The Other One, and the second set generally, as wildly psychedelic [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Louie, Louie**: rare: 9 archived performances [21]

## The recordings

- **gd88-05-01.sbd.jerugim.2206.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 152 min; rated 3.22/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer hears phase and spatial manipulation of instruments on the recording, which seemed absent from other archive shows; Reviewer judges the sound good [12][15]
- **gd1988-05-01.169161.Frost.PaloAlto.CA.fm.cm.pearson.miller.t-flac1648**: FM broadcast; 21 songs; 150 min [2]
- **gd1988-05-01.145596.fob.nak700.anon.noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 156 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd1988-05-01.ec7.bowen.foster.118671.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 148 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [6]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes occasional wind on the audience recording but considers it still sounds pretty good [20]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the band's tune-up lasted about 160 seconds, with chords that hinted at other songs [11]
- Attendee recalls the spatial and phasing effects were audible in the hall; the crowd wondered if it was their own altered state [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd88-05-01.sbd.jerugim.2206.sbefail.shnf**: source: DSBD->DAT Master->DAT Clone [1]. Also: Attendee says the show was broadcast on FM and they made copies at home, which captured the shifting effects well; Reviewer argues the source is a PCM digital soundboard master, not DAT, since Healy had no DAT then; Soundboard to DAT master to DAT clone; then CD, EAC, CDWave and SHN conversion, seeded by Adam Jerugim [1][14][15]
- **gd1988-05-01.169161.Frost.PaloAlto.CA.fm.cm.pearson.miller.t-flac1648**: taped by Don Pearson's collection; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  October 8, 2024; source: FM > Cassette Master (Maxell XLII/Dolby B) [2]
- **gd1988-05-01.145596.fob.nak700.anon.noel.t-flac16**: taped by Anon; transferred by Joe Noel; source: Lineage: Nakamichi 700 cardioids front of board -> tcd5m (master) -> Korg mr1000 (1 bit, 5.6 Mhz) -> render in AudioGate to 24 bits 48 khz sampling. [4]. Also: Jeff Bowen's source supplies the patch for Stuck Inside of Mobile; a tape flip in set one is cross-faded [4]
- **gd1988-05-01.ec7.bowen.foster.118671.flac16**: taped by Jeff Bowen; transferred by Jeff Bowen;Brad Foster; source: Source: (OTS/LOC) Superscope EC-7's [near coicident/cardioids] > Sony TC-153SD; [6]. Also: Taper used Superscope EC-7 cardioid microphones, his first mic set, for this audience recording [20]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Frost 1988](https://www.dead.net/fanphotos/frost-1988) [22]
- Poster by Kirsten Michel: [1988-04-30 Frost Amphitheatre, Palo Alto, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1988-04-30-frost-amphitheatre-palo-alto-ca-usa/) [23]
